items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: He come up with Bob Barber and that he come up with.

ctx.x: Little Sheik used to play at the palace, huh?
Sheik, yeah. Sheik. That ain't the way to call him. This is, oh what's his name? He come up with Bob Barber and that he come up with. Yeah, happy. Happy.
